name: After § 12
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 12a. Demands that the EU stop funding illegal migration, financing progressive media attacking Member States’ sovereignty, and promoting the spread of woke propaganda or war propaganda from the EU budget; requests, in this regard, that both direct or indirect support channelled through NGOs be stopped and that no money be spent on promoting the Commission’s false political agenda;
